The responsiveness of a local company, with a real system behind every visit

You should never have to wonder when your lawn was treated, what was applied, or who to call when something looks wrong.

  • Local knowledge: Programs built around our heat, humidity, rainfall, turf types, and weed cycles.
  • Clear communication: Service reminders, technician photos, and detailed follow-up after each visit.
  • No pressure: A straightforward estimate and month-to-month service without a long-term contract.
  • Nearby team: Serving Baton Rouge, Ascension, Livingston, and surrounding communities.

Good to know

Questions neighbors usually ask

How quickly will I receive my estimate?

Usually the same business day during office hours, or by the next business day during peak periods.

Do I have to sign a long-term contract?

No. The recurring lawn program is month-to-month. We want you to stay because you value the service, not because you are locked in.

How does the monthly price work?

The program includes eight treatments each year, usually about six weeks apart. The annual service cost is divided into 12 predictable monthly payments.

What areas do you service?

We serve much of Baton Rouge, Ascension Parish, Livingston Parish, and nearby communities, including Prairieville, Gonzales, St. Amant, Denham Springs, Walker, Central, and Zachary.

What happens after I submit the form?

Your request goes directly to the Grow Green office as a Nextdoor lead. A team member will review it and contact you about the estimate—there is no obligation to enroll.
